entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: A wizard who was a human apprentice in 3334 AR and later a Eumidian master assassin working for Ramses Overdark.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Wizard Xira served who sought Shauku's dominion.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Ancient vampire whose domain Johan sought.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Faced Xira at the Battle of Bryce.

entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: Faced Xira at the Battle of Bryce.

entities.name: Battle of Bryce
entities.description: Battle in 3334 AR in which Xira summoned Stone-Throwing Devils.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ordered Overdark to stop the Edemi uprising.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Rebellion leader Xira was sent to assassinate.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Infected with Xira's offspring and mutated; later killed by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which Xira worked for Overdark.

entities.name: Falling Star
entities.description: Meteor that annihilated Shauku's ruined castle.

events.summary: In 3334 AR, Xira fights at the Battle of Bryce against Hazezon Tamar and Jaeger Ojanen and flees when it turns against her.
events.quote: When the battle turned against her, she fled the scene.

events.summary: Xira joins Johan's entourage seeking Shauku's dominion and is made to wait outside, which saves her life when a Falling Star annihilates the castle.
events.quote: This would inadvertently save Xira Arien's life

events.summary: In 3607 AR, Xira resurfaces as a Eumidian master assassin working for Ramses Overdark and is sent to kill Lady Caleria.
events.quote: Xira was sent to assassinate the leader of the rebellion, Lady Caleria .

events.summary: Xira infects Kei Takahashi with her offspring to lure Tetsuo to Argenti; Tetsuo and Ayesha Tanaka kill it.
events.quote: Xira did this by infecting Kei Takahashi with her offspring.

events.summary: Tetsuo later tracks down and kills the mutated Kei.
events.quote: Tetsuo later tracked her down and killed her.
